thread:
tanya_cs: heads up — NovaHealth private deploy smoke test failing this morning. Two problems: 1) audit logs not reaching customer's SIEM (Splunk) 2) snapshots failing to decrypt with the KMS key. This is blocking cutover and the CSM noted a renewal concern if cutover slips >72h :rotating_light:
liam_eng: thanks. can you paste the most recent forwarder log and the KMS key alias? also subnet IDs for the egress path pls. :eyes:
rahul_infra: curious — most likely an egress ACL or KMS grant scope. i can check key policy; do we have the customer AWS account id and the key ARN?
sam_ops: quick check — can you curl the forwarder endpoint from inside the priv gateway pod? e.g.:
```
curl -v http://127.0.0.1:9080/forwarder/health || true
```
-ingest-bot: alert: log-forwarder(novahealth): 504 gateway timeout to splunk.int.svc (ts=2024-11-12T09:13:12Z)
tanya_cs: paste of forwarder tail below — last lines show repeated 502/504s:
```
[2024-11-12T09:12:58Z] forwarder.ERROR request failed status=502 resp_time=1203ms
[2024-11-12T09:13:12Z] forwarder.ERROR request failed status=504 resp_time=30001ms
[2024-11-12T09:13:48Z] forwarder.INFO retrying batch (attempt=3)
```
liam_eng: ok looks like egress path to splunk endpoint is getting rate-limited or blocked. tanya — subnet IDs?
tanya_cs: subnets: subnet-0a1b2c3d, subnet-0d3c2b1a. KMS key alias: alias/redwood/novahealth-logs. customer acct id: 123456789012 (we have cross-account role set up).
rahul_infra: thanks. running quick policy check now. in case — try this to list grants:
```
aws kms list-grants --key-id alias/redwood/novahealth-logs --profile novahealth-cust
```
rahul_infra: also check the key's key policy doesn't deny cross-account decrypts — common failure when customer rotates restrictive policy. i'll ping infra to run a temporary test grant.
sam_ops: i'll exec into forwarder pod and run the curl above, and tail syslogs. if it's rate limit we'll see 429s or connection resets. posting results in 5m.
liam_eng: when you have the exec output, include pod name + node; helps with MTU/usual NAT issues.
tanya_cs: FYI CS flagged renewal risk tier=medium if unresolved by EOD Friday (72h). i'll schedule a joint enablement call for tomorrow 15:00 PST with NovaHealth and bring liam/rahul. sending calendar now. :calendar:
ingest-bot: deployment-bot: runbook triggered — "priv-net/egress-troubleshooting" assigned to @sam_ops @rahul_infra
sam_ops: exec done — forwarder pod forwarder-7cbd9 on node ip-10-4-2-11: curl returned 504 consistently, tcpdump shows SYN retransmits to splunk.int.svc:9997. suspect firewall NAT gateway dropping long-lived connections.
rahul_infra: i'm going to request customer infra to temporarily allow traffic to splunk.int.svc:9997 from those subnets and add a grant to the KMS key for our cross-account role. will post CLI output when done.
liam_eng: if that fixes logs but KMS still fails, we should run a small decrypt test using aws kms decrypt with the cross-account role to capture the exact error.
tanya_cs: appreciated. capturing action items for the enablement call: 1) rahul to confirm grant + key policy 2) sam to validate egress allow + NAT behavior 3) liam to run decrypt test + bring small repro 4) tanya to monitor renewal tracker and update AE. please react when ack'ed. :thumbsup:
liam_eng: ack :thumbsup:
rahul_infra: ack, starting on grant now.
sam_ops: ack, will attach tcpdump + exec logs to the thread after I scrub IPs.
tanya_cs: adding note for CSM docs — feedback: customer wants clearer pre-cutover KMS checklist and a short network diagnostics playbook included in onboarding packet. filing a doc request.
liam_eng: good call — i'll draft a 1-pager and post to onboarding/docs for review.
tanya_cs: thanks team. i'll stand up the calendar invite and loop the customer. if we don't have resolution within 72h i'll escalate to renewals. :rotating_light:
